name: Bug island
summary: Four chips lie inside an immutable fire ring, with no fire boots.
proofSteps: The file contains 34 chips and requires 33. Four chips are at (26, 10),(27, 11),(26, 12),(27, 13), inside the rectangle x 24..29, y 8..15.
Every boundary cell of that rectangle is top-layer Fire. None has a concealed alternate floor that could be exposed; the four chips lie strictly inside. There is no teleporter inside the rectangle.
Neither layer contains fire boots. Chip cannot survive crossing Fire. There is no mechanism in this level that creates fire boots or opens a hole in this ring.

MS ordinary blocks can move onto Fire but do not remove it; the block arrival switch changes Water/Bomb, not Fire. Pushing such a block off reveals the same Fire, so blocks cannot form a safe bridge. Monsters also do not remove Fire.

Consequently all four interior chips are permanently inaccessible, giving at most 30 collectible chips, below 33 required. Both approaches to the only Exit (31, 0) are sockets (30, 0),(31, 1); the other sides are board boundaries. Thus no exit bypass exists.

experiments.result: Exact DAT metadata/layers decoded; initial production runtime loaded and rendered with repository sprites.

limitations: Ordinary legal MS play; cheats/editor changes excluded.
sourceEvidence: legacy_c/mslogic.c:1713-1737 (monster hazard effects do not extinguish Fire)
